issue: SENTENCE record with empty textContent

issue: REASONS record with empty textContent
note: reasons announced but not published
treatment: Retain if reasons exist elsewhere; otherwise exclude.

issue: judgment date outside 1990–2026 or unparseable
note: typos in the source, e.g. year 208 or 3013
treatment: Correct documented typos; audit the rest.

issue: published before the judgment date
note: publication_date earlier than judgment_date
treatment: Retain; audit. Do not use publication_date.

issue: reasons record dated before its sentence
note: in cases with separate SENTENCE and REASONS records
treatment: Retain if valid; flag the date anomaly.

issue: reasons record dated > 1 year after its sentence
note: REASONS judgment_date is often the date reasons were written, not the ruling date
treatment: Retain if valid; flag the date anomaly.

note: most common shapes [('IN C N/N', 1271), ('I N C N/N', 151), ('IIN C N/N', 130), ('XII NCo N/N', 82)]

issue: of which a digit after the division numeral (I 2C 15/13)
note: sub-divisions numbered with digits in a few courts
treatment: Implementation change required: parse sub-divisions; retain if paired.

issue: case with more than one SENTENCE record
note: same court and signature, several sentences (re-trial, partial judgment or duplicate upload)
treatment: Implementation change required: deterministic record selection; audit ambiguity.

issue: case key shared by 3+ records
note: out of cases with more than one record

issue: labour / social-insurance signature outside a labour division

treatment: Corrected in parser.

issue: other signature inside a labour division
note: codes seen {'S': 89}
treatment: Review mapping; exclude unresolved mismatches.

issue: record without any judge
treatment: Retain if otherwise valid; leave judge missing.

issue: judge name anonymised to initials
note: anonymisation applied to the bench, not only to parties
treatment: Retain; treat judge feature as missing.

issue: record without a presiding judge in the modelling set
note: 398 rows lack the role marker: 340 have no judge, 54 have exactly one judge (role is unambiguous), and 4 have multiple judges without a role marker

issue: two judges in one name field

treatment: Implementation change required: validate name splitting.

issue: record without keywords
treatment: Retain; optional metadata.

issue: record without legal bases
treatment: Retain if valid; leave legal bases missing.

issue: record without summary
treatment: Retain; optional metadata.

issue: appeal sentence without text
treatment: Exclude from labels; retain for audit.

note: reopening (skarga o wznowienie), typos, transcripts

issue: header without a first-instance signature
